speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical myelopathy secondary to cervical spondylotic myelopathy.

The patient's history of burning pain, paresthesias, and progressive bilateral hand weakness over a year, combined with his age and vascular risk factors, strongly suggests compression of the cervical spinal cord. The one-year duration and bilateral nature of the symptoms are classic for this condition rather than simple radiculopathy.
